requirement_text: All bachelor programmes for which you can enrol at UGent are instructed in Dutch. You cannot enrol without a valid proof of the required level of Dutch. Dutch at level B2 is required upon enrolment for most bachelor programmes. Level C1 is required for the Bachelor of Arts in Applied Language Studies (Bachelor of Arts in de toegepaste taalkunde).
source_authority_note: ugent.be is the official domain of Ghent University (website_url on the matched universities row is https://www.ugent.be). Belgian national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
limitations: An AI search summary in this session asserted 'with the exception of the Bachelor of Social Sciences'. The fetched page says ALL bachelor programmes, with no exception. The unverified carve-out is NOT recorded. If a later pass finds an English-taught UGent bachelor's, that is a conflict to record, not a correction to apply silently.
researcher_notes: Second of two Belgian institutions and the second Flemish one, but the opposite answer to KU Leuven on English-taught bachelor's entry: Ghent has none. Same country, same language community, same regulator -- and a decisive difference for an international applicant. Country-level generalisation would have hidden it.

requirement_text: All students are required to demonstrate language proficiency at the latest upon enrolment. ... You do not need to already meet the language requirements when starting up the admission procedure.
source_authority_note: ugent.be is the official domain of Ghent University (website_url on the matched universities row is https://www.ugent.be). Belgian national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
researcher_notes: The language bar binds at ENROLMENT, not at application. A student may legitimately apply while still reaching B2. Modelling the requirement without its timing point would tell them not to apply at all.

program_name: Bachelor of Science in Medicine / Dentistry / Veterinary Medicine
requirement_text: There is an inter-university entrance examination in Medicine, Dentistry or Veterinary Medicine. If you wish to enrol for Bachelor of Science in Medicine, Bachelor of Science in Dentistry or Bachelor of Science in Veterinary Medicine, you will need to pass and have a favourable ranking. All information is available on Entrance examinations of the Flemish Community (information in Dutch only).
source_authority_note: ugent.be is the official domain of Ghent University (website_url on the matched universities row is https://www.ugent.be). Belgian national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
limitations: The examination is operated by the FLEMISH COMMUNITY, not by Ghent University, and its authoritative information is published in Dutch only. Ghent is a restating party here, not the source of record. The exam's own dates and content were not fetched in this pass and are NOT recorded.
researcher_notes: The language-community structure the brief flagged, in its sharpest form: the gate to medicine at any Flemish university is a single community-level exam, so it is neither a university requirement nor a Belgian national one. Belgium cannot be modelled at country level. Note also 'pass AND have a favourable ranking' -- passing is necessary and not sufficient, because places are capped; a pass/fail flag is the wrong shape.

requirement_text: Note that certain programmes require you to participate in a positioning test or that you have passed the entrance examination and have obtained favourable ranking. ... Some programs require you to participate in a mandatory positioning test in order to enrol.
source_authority_note: ugent.be is the official domain of Ghent University (website_url on the matched universities row is https://www.ugent.be). Belgian national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
limitations: Two distinct instruments with different force: the ENTRANCE EXAMINATION must be passed with a favourable ranking, while the POSITIONING TEST (ijkingstoets) requires PARTICIPATION only -- there is no pass mark. Collapsing both into 'entrance exam required' would tell a prospective engineering student they can fail their way out of a programme they cannot.
researcher_notes: A mandatory test with no threshold is a genuinely new shape for the corpus. It is a procedural precondition, not an assessment.

requirement_text: If your diploma is listed here-below, you will need to start up your enrolment application online. ... Your diploma is considered equivalent to the Flemish diploma of secondary education and admission will be approved from as soon as your enrolment application is complete. [Routes listed: a Belgian degree; a diploma/degree certificate from abroad (LRC-countries and International Organisations) from the list of equivalent secondary education qualifications; a foreign diploma declared equivalent by NARIC; a foreign university bachelor or master diploma, correctly certified/legalised.]
source_authority_note: ugent.be is the official domain of Ghent University (website_url on the matched universities row is https://www.ugent.be). Belgian national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
limitations: Route list flattened from bullets. The referenced list of equivalent qualifications and the NARIC decision process were not fetched in this pass.
researcher_notes: 'Direct admission' in Belgium is an automatic-recognition track, distinct from being individually assessed. Which track a student is on is decided by their country and qualification, not by their grades.

requirement_text: Most diplomas that are not on the list are not considered equivalent. In that case, you will need to provide proof of at least one successful year of university-level studies in addition to your secondary school diploma. ... You have completed at least 60 ECTS credits (or the full-time equivalent) at a recognized university. You passed the majority of your courses (not just enrolled).
source_authority_note: ugent.be is the official domain of Ghent University (website_url on the matched universities row is https://www.ugent.be). Belgian national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
limitations: For most non-EU applicants the secondary diploma alone is insufficient at ANY grade. No amount of academic strength at school level substitutes; the missing element is a year of university study. A requirement model built on grade thresholds cannot express 'this is not a grade problem'.
researcher_notes: The single most actionable finding for an ORYN user targeting Ghent, and the one most likely to be discovered too late. A 17-year-old planning for Ghent needs to know at the planning stage that their route probably runs through a first year at a home university -- which is advice about sequencing, not about improving a score.

requirement_text: If your qualification allows you to enrol in the same programme in your home country, you may be eligible to apply for that programme at Ghent University.
source_authority_note: ugent.be is the official domain of Ghent University (website_url on the matched universities row is https://www.ugent.be). Belgian national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A).
researcher_notes: Same home-country-access principle as Lund's general eligibility rule. Two unconnected systems converging on it suggests it is a European norm worth modelling explicitly rather than as an institutional quirk.
